definitions.gloss: drainage; water permeability; how well water drains
definitions.explanation: The ability of soil, ground, or a surface to allow water to drain away. Commonly discussed in gardening, agriculture, and construction contexts.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}はけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}たまり→水たまり：19427_mizutamari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Puddles formed in places with poor drainage.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花壇|かだん}→花壇：11075_kadan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水|みず}はけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{砂利|じゃり}→砂利：14948_jari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{混|ま}ぜた→混ぜる：02423_mazeru⟧。
examples.english: I mixed in gravel to improve the drainage of the flower bed.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧ (water) + はけ (draining away). Can also be written {水捌|みずは}け. Almost always appears in the patterns {水|みず}はけ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧ (good drainage) or {水|みず}はけ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (poor drainage).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水|みず}はけ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧: good drainage
- {水|みず}はけ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: poor drainage
- {水|みず}はけ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改善|かいぜん}する→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧: to improve drainage
- {水|みず}はけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧: well-draining soil

USAGE:
Essential vocabulary for gardening in Japanese. Many plants require {水|みず}はけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧ (well-draining soil), making this a practical word for anyone interested in Japanese gardening or agriculture.
